Frequently
asked questions

What is an ERP system, and how does it benefit small to medium businesses?

An ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system integrates various business processes, such as finance, HR, supply chain, and customer relationship management, into a single unified platform. This helps SMBs improve efficiency, reduce manual tasks, enhance data accuracy, and provide comprehensive insights for better decision-making. 

LEARN MORE
What are the main challenges an ERP system can solve for small to medium businesses?

ERP systems can address challenges such as data silos, inconsistent data across departments, manual errors, and time-consuming reporting. They streamline operations, improve collaboration, and provide real-time visibility into business performance, helping businesses operate more efficiently.  

LEARN MORE
Can an ERP system help reduce operational costs?

Yes, an ERP system helps identify inefficiencies and automate routine tasks, reducing the need for manual labor and minimizing human errors. This leads to better resource management and cost savings across various business functions. 

LEARN MORE
How does an ERP system enhance customer relationship management for SMBs?

An ERP system can integrate customer data from different sources, providing a 360-degree view of customer interactions. This helps improve service quality, personalize customer experiences, and ensure timely follow-ups, leading to increased customer satisfaction and retention.  

LEARN MORE
How can an ERP system improve inventory management for my business?

ERP systems offer real-time tracking and automation of inventory levels, ensuring you have the right products at the right time without overstocking or stockouts. This improves order fulfillment, reduces waste, and optimizes warehouse operations. 

LEARN MORE
What reporting and data analytics capabilities do ERP systems provide?

ERP systems offer powerful reporting and analytics tools that compile data from multiple departments into clear, actionable insights. This helps business owners and managers make informed decisions based on accurate, real-time data, fostering strategic planning and growth. 

LEARN MORE
Are ERP systems adaptable to the specific needs of different industries?

Yes, modern ERP systems are highly adaptable and offer industry-specific solutions tailored to sectors such as manufacturing, retail, services, and more. Custom modules and configurations can be designed to fit the unique requirements of any business type. 

LEARN MORE
What are the main benefits of implementing an ERP system for financial management?

ERP systems enhance financial management by providing automated accounting processes, real-time financial data, and comprehensive reporting tools. This results in better financial tracking, improved compliance with regulations, and more efficient financial close cycles. 

LEARN MORE
Can an ERP system assist in scaling my business?

Absolutely. ERP systems are designed to grow with your business. They offer scalability by allowing you to add new features, users, and capabilities as your company expands, ensuring your processes remain streamlined as your business evolves.

LEARN MORE

arch_base:
Why Odoo?

What is Odoo ERP?

Odoo is a scalable SaaS ERP solution suitable for businesses of all sizes, from startups to multinationals. It provides a comprehensive suite of apps for essential functions like sales, CRM, inventory, and accounting, all accessible through the Odoo App Store. By centralizing data and automating operations, Odoo simplifies processes, reduces costs, and improves efficiency.

With over 7 million users globally, Odoo continually updates with new features and third-party integrations, including Oracle and Salesforce. Its cloud-based architecture allows for quick setup and offers both online and offline access, with robust security measures to protect your data.

Odoo is the perfect ERP solution for businesses aiming to streamline operations and drive digital transformation.

 

Why you should choose Odoo 

Making business dreams a reality.

Rethink business management with Odoo. Empower your teams to streamline operations and manage workflows efficiently—all in one platform—so your IT team can focus on strategic innovations, not routine tasks.

Open Source

Supporting the technology is a global community of over +100K developers working together.  Community: Open Source and completely free. Enterprise: Includes additional apps, infrastructure, and professional services.

Cost-effectiveness

No usage-based pricing, no upselling on features, no long-term contracts, no hosting limits, and no surprises—just one straightforward, all-inclusive price per user.

Highly Customizable & Scalable

Leverage Odoo Studio to automate tasks, design custom screens, generate tailored reports, and set up webhooks. Plus, enhance your experience by using our specialized services to customize it to your specific needs. Odoo adapts to any business size or industry, with the flexibility to add or remove features as needed.

User-friendly & Accessible

With an intuitive interface and mobile access, Odoo is easy to use anytime, anywhere.

Real-time Analytics & Collaboration

With an intuitive interface and mobile access, Odoo is easy to use anytime, anywhere.

Quick Implementation

Odoo is straightforward to deploy, making setup a breeze.

Learn More arrow_right_alt

Advanced Inventory Management System



Minimize stockouts, accelerate operations, ensure seamless replenishment, simplify reservations, optimize routes, and gain real-time visibility with Odoo's Warehouse Management app.

Eliminate Time-Wasting Tasks and Focus on What Truly Matters: Making Sales!


Streamline your sales orders, customer service, and eCommerce operations on one unified platform. Leverage CRM to manage customer relationships and create custom pricing strategies. By integrating manufacturing and your website with the sales process, you can quickly update and keep customers informed.

Integrated Financials

Odoo offers seamless multi-company support, smart bank reconciliation, and multi-currency management. With automated payment follow-ups and batch payments, it streamlines your financial operations. Additionally, you gain valuable insights through analytic distribution reports.

The Leading Integrated Project Management Software

Predict project requirements and efficiently allocate resources. Simplify workflows and foster collaboration among team members. Keep track of project budgets, allow employees to log timesheets, and unlock the full potential of your data with detailed reporting and in-depth analysis.

HR and Timesheets is Way More Than Just a Staff Directory.

Streamline employee registration and onboarding plans. Benefit from smart time tracking and attendance management. Simplify the employee evaluation process and efficiently manage your fleet with integrated solutions.

All-in-one app for all your business needs

  • Inventory & Manufacturing

  • Human Resource Application

  • Marketing Application

  • Services Application

  • Productivity Application

Website Builder

Create a professional website with hosting and a domain name. Includes marketing tools, live chat, social media integration, and web push notifications. AI suggests layouts and content based on your industry. User-friendly interface allows drag-and-drop, layout adjustments, filters, and animations.

eCommerce

 Design templates, set up your store, and apply sales tax automatically. The platform is mobile-friendly, SEO optimized, and integrates with Google Analytics. Create product pages using a drag-and-drop builder. Use a unified platform for marketing and operations with real-time stock updates, boosting revenue and retention while generating advanced reports.

Blog

Odoo Blog is an excellent content management system for showcasing ideas, engaging audiences, and building communities. Create and format text, insert media, and structure content directly from the frontend. Produce appealing content easily and improve your search engine ranking to attract more visitors.

Forum

Understand and respond to leads and customers. Reward active members. Improve ranking with Google Analytics.


Odoo Forum builds community, boosts traffic, and enhances support. Enable user discussions, gain insights, and reward with Karma points. Use the advanced text editor for content creation.

Live Chat

Odoo Live Chat lets you engage with customers and visitors in real time, boosting satisfaction and efficiency. Receive notifications and chat across all Odoo apps, converting conversations into support tickets seamlessly. Turn visitors into potential sales effortlessly.

eLearning

Odoo's open-source Learning Management System (LMS) lets tutors share content, perform assessments, and provide certifications. Easily create courses, upload content, and engage students. Assess progress and offer certifications to validate skills.

Sales

Odoo’s Sales platform sends online quotations, automates contracts, and manages pricing. Customers access documents online. Save time with online payments and e-signatures. AI scores leads and generates them from various sources. Integrates pricing with eCommerce, Inventory, and Manufacturing. Includes promotions, loyalty programs, coupons, gift cards, and eWallet.

Point of Sale

Self-ordering via kiosk or smartphone for seamless customer experience. Streamline cross-channel sales with online orders and in-store pickups. Enhance loyalty with points, rewards, gift cards, and easy payment methods.


Rental

Odoo’s rental platform streamlines operations from scheduling to tracking and profitability analysis. Manage products, schedule pickups, and sign documents in one place. Integrate with Odoo’s eCommerce for easy online booking and reservations. Customize pricing for different time frames, and track rentals and invoices with a simple dashboard. 

CRM

Odoo’s CRM tracks potential customers, schedules activities, and enhances collaboration. Automate calls, meetings, mailings, and quotations. Integrates with email, live chat, SMS, and VoIP. Create quotations quickly and use real-time data for smart decisions.


Subscriptions

Manage subscriptions effortlessly with Odoo. Increase customers through easy signup, create lasting relationships, and optimise operations. Automate recurring sales, clear contracts, and invoices. Handle taxes and payments automatically. Speed up sales with contract templates. Focus on providing great services while Odoo handles the rest.


Accounting

Simplify accounting with Odoo’s finance app. The dashboard organizes invoices and bills with AI-powered capture for 98% accuracy. Manage expenses on your mobile device, and enjoy smart bank reconciliation with 28,000 banks. Access real-time financial reports for informed decisions, and ensure tax compliance for cross-border transactions.

Expenses

Odoo Expenses simplifies expense management. When an employee submits expenses through Odoo, they are reviewed by the management and accounting teams. Once approved, payments can be processed and reimbursed to the employee.

Sign

 Odoo enables swift, legally valid electronic signatures for contracts. Odoo Sign simplifies sending, signing, and approving documents online with drag-and-drop fields and pre-filled templates. Track document status, send reminders, and monitor progress. Ensure cryptographic traceability and SMS authentication.

Invoicing

Odoo's accounting dashboard lets you create, manage, and track invoices with detailed payment reports. Invoicing is just a click away with customer details and tax rates. Use the mobile app for invoicing, payment updates, and batch payments. Enable online payments, manage recurring invoices, issue refunds, and accept multiple currencies with automatic conversion updates.

Documents

Go paperless with Odoo. Manage electronic documents seamlessly with Odoo Documents, centralizing file management and eliminating scanning. Enjoy automatic dispatch, digitalization, and online signing. Organize by workspace and tags, and access files instantly to declutter your desktop.

Spreadsheet

No export-import hassle with Odoo. Data updates automatically in charts and spreadsheets. Create dynamic reports with real-time updates using a pivot view. Access all information from one customizable dashboard with visual representations. Use easy menus for formulas, transform data into charts, and apply smart filters to find specific information quickly.


Inventory

Odoo's warehouse management app reduces stockouts, speeds up operations, and provides real-time visibility. Improve efficiency with streamlined stocking, smart replenishment, and automated purchase orders. Enhance receipt, quality control, and storage with real-time inventory management. Quickly locate products, minimize picking movements, and integrate with carriers for shipping labels and packing units.

Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)
